decisive_items: 2 heterozygous variants in the LTBP2 gene
lens dislocation superonasally in the right eye
response.rationale: The presence of biallelic LTBP2 mutations, ectopia lentis, and elevated intraocular pressure strongly support Weill-Marchesani syndrome, despite atypical tall stature and hypermobility. Marfan is less likely due to normal echocardiograms and negative family history.

rejected.why: Hypermobility is present but lens dislocation and LTBP2 mutations are not typical for Ehlers-Danlos syndrome.
Tall stature and lens dislocation are suggestive, but normal echocardiograms and negative family history argue against Marfan syndrome.
Elevated IOP and lens dislocation are present, but open angle and young age are atypical for pseudoexfoliation syndrome.
